title: Trajectory Record
description: One record per document, per arm, per configuration. PRD v0.2 section 8 contract plus additive extensions required by the architecture (see docs/architecture.md section 8). ADDITIVE ONLY: no field from the v0.2 contract is renamed, retyped, or removed, so any record written against v0.2 still validates here.

schema_version.description: Bump only on a breaking change. Additive extensions do not bump this.

run_id.description: blake2b over seed, config, uv.lock, model SHA256s, llama.cpp build hash, corpus SHA. See ADR-0006.

concurrency.description: DEPRECATED alias retained for v0.2 compatibility. Prefer offered_concurrency. Writers SHOULD emit both with the same value.

offered_concurrency.description: ADDITIVE. Requests in flight from the client. This is the P0-9 axis. Above server_slots, load QUEUES rather than batches.

server_slots.description: ADDITIVE. llama.cpp --parallel N actually resident: the real batching width. Reporting a queued-128 result as a batched-128 result is the easiest serious error available here.

ctx_per_slot.description: ADDITIVE. --ctx-size divided by server_slots. Concurrency is KV-bound, not compute-bound.

kv_cache_dtype.description: ADDITIVE. KV quantization is an accuracy confound; Pass A uses f16, Pass B may use q8_0. Records are not separable without this.

host.description: ADDITIVE. Two serving nodes write to this schema (ADR-0010).

vram_cap_gb.description: 20 on the test rig per PRD D11, asserted at runtime.

extraction.description: Deterministic tier. Cost, latency, and success logged SEPARATELY from inference (P0-3).

fully_satisfied_schema.description: ADDITIVE. True when NO LLM call was needed at all. Drives the P0-12 headline: share of work absorbed by the deterministic tier.

confidence_aggregation.description: ADDITIVE. Field confidence is derived, not native (ADR-0002). Name the function so it can be audited.

ttft_ms.description: ADDITIVE. Prefill is compute-bound and modeled separately (PRD section 7). TTFT is the batch-vs-interactive scorecard dimension; v0.2 carried only total latency.

grammar_constrained.description: ADDITIVE, LOAD-BEARING. Logprobs under a GBNF/JSON-schema mask are POST-MASK and systematically over-confident: a token can show near-certainty only because the grammar forbade every alternative. P1-2 calibration is INVALID if it mixes constrained and unconstrained decodes without segmenting on this.

sampler.description: ADDITIVE. R1 resamples k=3; those records must be separable from greedy R0 records.

via_batch_api.description: ADDITIVE. Cloud bulk passes run through the Batch API at 50% cost. Latency from these records is NOT reportable and is excluded from every latency chart.

retries.description: ADDITIVE. Transport-level retries (429/5xx). Distinct from a rung transition. Without this, rate-limit backoff is indistinguishable from real latency.

truth.description: Computed INDEPENDENTLY of the gate. The two axes are never collapsed.

outcome.description: Derived from final.gate_passed x truth.is_correct. SILENT_FAILURE = gate passed, answer wrong. Reported standalone, never averaged into aggregate success (PRD D9).

energy_source.description: ADDITIVE, REQUIRED, HIGHEST PRIORITY of the extensions. The test rig models power from spec sheets while the Mac node measures it via powermetrics (ADR-0008). Without this field that distinction is unrecoverable the moment anyone opens the CSV, and a modeled figure gets compared to the PRD section 2 baseline's SYSTEM watts as though it were the same quantity.

rate_card_id.description: ADDITIVE. Claude Sonnet 5 introductory pricing expires 2026-08-31, inside the build window. Cost comparisons across runs must assert matching rate_card_id and refuse to plot otherwise.

amortized_hardware_usd.description: ADDITIVE. PRD section 12 asks for both marginal energy and amortized hardware cost, always. Marginal wins technical arguments; amortized is what a CFO budgets.
